description: Fork of exp724 (E=384, d_v=64, residual/emb_resid NAP=6, out_proj NAP=7, bs=48 16K = 1.1936 @ 276.83M). Single change: enable self-consistent input gradient via hybrid_smooth_autograd=True + hybrid_smooth_save_memory=True. hybrid_smooth_n_alt set per-module = the module's NAP (full Hamming-1 ball). Forward uses (NAP+1)-row softmax blend; backward uses plain autograd through the same gather, so input gradient flows ONLY through rows touched in forward (no soft K-row surrogate). Tests if the self-consistent input grad helps at exp724-scale. Tradeoff: needs grad_accum due to autograd activation retention — bs=24 grad_accum=2 = 24*512*2 = 24576 tokens/step (same effective batch as exp724 bs=48). Anchor: exp724=1.1936 @ 276.83M (manual K-row surrogate input grad).
